clauses.scope_note: The Software and any portion of it. Without prior written permission from the copyright holder, the text prohibits use, running, or deployment; copying or creating derivatives; distribution, publication, sublicensing, or making it available to third parties; selling or offering it as a free, open-source, or otherwise unrestricted product; and removing or altering proprietary notices. It also states that unauthorized use, reproduction, or distribution is prohibited. The sale restriction is limited to the specified kinds of product; the text does not state a general ban on charging for other uses.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee has not obtained prior written permission from the copyright holder. The text does not specify the content or scope of any permission that might be granted.

coverage_notes: The supplied text is a proprietary-license notice, not a grant of general rights. It does not expressly authorize any activity absent written permission.

No operative terms address combining, linking, network services, remote interaction, source provision, training, payment obligations, or rights in inputs or outputs; silence does not establish permission or prohibition for those activities.
The warranty and liability disclaimer and licensing-inquiry contact are omitted as unrelated to the requested activities.
